For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

As an Administrative & Operations Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of daily operational activities across payments, cash management, trade finance, and client administration.

Known for its expertise in corporate banking, financial services, and global markets, the company offers a collaborative environment where innovation, operational excellence, and long-term client relationships are at the heart of its success.

Description

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.
• Manage incoming client requests and internal inquiries via email and phone.
• Support administrative follow-up of banking operations and client files.
• Assist with Trade Finance and Guarantee-related transactions.
• Maintain and update client documentation and e-banking agreements.
• Perform reconciliations, operational controls, and account maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.

This Junior Administrative Assistant role offers the opportunity to support daily office operations, manage communication flows, and assist various departments with key administrative tasks. It's an ideal first job for someone eager to learn, grow, and develop strong organisational and professional skills in a dynamic environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well‑established and dynamic company located in Brussels. They offer a stimulating work environment where professionals can grow, develop new skills, and build a long‑term career. Due to continued expansion, they are looking for a motivated Administrative Assistant to join their team.

Description

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting daily office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Preparing and formatting documents, reports, and presentations
• Supporting various departments with administrative tasks
• Handling agendas, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
• Ensuring proper filing and data management
• Assisting with internal communication and basic logistics
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient functioning of the office

• You are graduated in Administration, Office Management, Languages, Business, or equivalent
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Organized, detail‑oriented, and eager to take initiative
• Communicative, proactive, and capable of working in a fast‑paced environment
• Motivated to kickstart your career in administration and open to learning on the job

This Junior HR Assistant position gives the opportunity to support core HR processes, from recruitment coordination to employee administration and onboarding. It's the ideal first step for someone who wants to develop strong HR skills and grow within a dynamic, people‑focused environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is an international and people‑oriented company based in Brussels. They are known for their strong company culture, internal mobility, and commitment to developing talent. To support their growing HR department, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior HR Assistant ready to discover the world of Human Resources.

Omschrijving

As a Junior HR Assistant, you will support the HR team across a variety of tasks, giving you a broad introduction to the field. Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting with the recruitment process: job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews
• Supporting the onboarding of new employees
• Handling HR administration: contracts, personnel files, absences, certificates
• Preparing HR documents and ensuring updated employee data
• Helping with payroll preparation by collecting and verifying information
• Participating in HR projects such as employer branding, training coordination, or wellbeing initiatives
• Being a point of contact for employees, providing clear and friendly support

• You graduated in HR, Psychology, Office Management, Business, or a related field
• Eager to start your career and develop strong HR skills
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
• Organized, communicative, and service‑minded
• Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable handling confidential information
• A real team player who enjoys working with people

Are you a technical talent with a passion for innovation? Join a high-tech company at the forefront of the automotive semiconductor industry and help shape the technology of tomorrow.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.
As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.

You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.
You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.

Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.
